field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Expose every tool of an enabled MCP server to the assistant as a skill.

field.label: Also discover from .mcp.json
field.comment: Read the Claude Code / Cursor .mcp.json in the Magento root in addition to Composer packages.

field.label: Call timeout (seconds)
field.comment: How long one tool call may take, over stdio or HTTP, before it is abandoned; a server row may set its own.

field.label: Tool list cache lifetime (seconds)
field.comment: Tool lists are cached in the "mago_mcp" cache type.

field.label: Maximum result characters
field.comment: Longer tool results are truncated before they reach the model (about 4 characters per token).

field.label: MCP worker address
field.comment: A local MCP server is a process. The admin never starts processes itself; it asks the MCP worker (bin/magento mago:mcp:serve), which runs on the command line, at this host:port. On one server keep the default. When the worker runs in another container, give that container's name, for example php-cli:8765.

field.label: MCP worker listens on
field.comment: Empty: the worker address. Set it only when the worker must bind another address than the one the admin uses, for example 0.0.0.0:8765 inside a container. Never publish this port outside the server or its private container network.

field.label: Keep the MCP worker running
field.comment: Magento's cron starts the worker within a minute while at least one local server is enabled, replaces it after a deploy, and stops it when no local server is enabled. Set to No when supervisor or systemd runs it.
